blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model’s context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.
blocks.zh: Wikidata是最大的开放知识库之一,然而在回答关于它的一个复杂问题时,仍然需要一个SPARQL查询,以命名正确的实体和属性,并链接它们的关系. 语言模型提供了一个自然语言的可选方案,但主要从记忆中解答,这对不太突出的实体来说最不可靠. 我们研究通过探索图表来回答问题的代理商,并争论说有两个障碍限制了它们:缺乏训练数据记录一个解题者如何探索,以及接口将大图表结果直接添加到模型的背景中. 我们测试了三种假设: 图搜索的难度可以通过一个问题的结构来控制,而不只是通过模糊的实体或措辞来控制;长视搜索的失败大多来自如何管理所取出的证据,而不是模型本身;在合适的环境中,开放量级模型可以匹配被商业关闭的模型. 我们在被冻结的Wikidata快照上构建多跳题,将命名的实体替换为嵌入条件,每次扩张后检查目标是否依然独特,每个新条件是否必要. 我们释放了10,235个解决单实体和多跳问题上的痕迹,以及产生这些痕迹的递归语言模型(RLM)取用,其中模型批量图表调用,保持持续Python状态的结果,并通过分调解释选定的证据. 在100个问题中,与直接工具调用相同的功能相比,这种牵引装置改进了我们在两个接口下运行的两个模型:gpt-6-luna从49个正确答案升至61个,将它的多跳精度翻了一番;而Qune3.8-27B是一个在单一GPU上服务的开量模型,从60个升至74个.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Wikidata has become the leading infrastructure for the semantic web and for general-purpose structured open data [ 1 ] . It describes more than 100 million entities and is maintained by a volunteer community. Originally built for Wikimedia projects, it is now used by cultural heritage institutions, researchers, commercial services. It is also a major common ground for semantic databases in multiple industrial sectors, either through straight data integration, inspiration for data harmonization and ontology or query federation.
blocks.zh: Wikidata已经成为语义网络和通用结构化开放数据的主要基础设施[1]. 它描述了一亿多个实体,由一个志愿者社区维护。 最初为维基媒体项目而建,现在被文化遗产机构,研究人员,商业服务使用. 它也是多个工业部门语义数据库的主要共同点,通过直接的数据整合、数据统一灵感和本体学或查询联合会。

blocks.en: Conversational language models are becoming a common way to ask factual questions and rely more and more on internet or local databases. Yet, Wikidata and the wider semantic web remain poorly integrated in this emerging search environment. A language model answers mostly from what it memorized during training, which is least reliable for less prominent entities [ 2 , 3 ] , and it gives no account of where an answer comes from. A knowledge graph holds explicit, sourced statements, but only users who can write structured queries can combine them. A model that answers by consulting the graph rather than recalling it would bring together the accessibility of the first and the verifiability of the second.
blocks.zh: 对话语言模式正在成为一种常见的方法,用以提出事实问题并越来越多地依赖互联网或当地数据库。 然而,Wikidata和更广泛的语义网络在这种新兴的搜索环境中仍然没有很好地整合. 一种语言模型主要从其在培训期间所记住的内容来回答,对于不太突出的实体来说,这最不可靠[2,3],它没有说明答案来自何处. 一个知识图持有明确的,源代码的语句,但只有能够写出结构化查询的用户才能将其组合. 一种通过查阅图表而不是回顾来回答问题的模型,将使第一个图表的无障碍性和第二个图表的可核查性结合起来。

blocks.en: Consulting the graph is itself difficult. To write a SPARQL query, a user must identify the relevant entities and properties, follow the direction of their relations and express joins between the conditions of the question. Natural-language interfaces have mostly framed this as semantic parsing: LC-QuAD 2.0 and KQA Pro pair questions with executable representations, and the Wikidata Query Logs dataset (WDQL) derives question–query pairs from real query logs [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . This framing assumes that a question can be mapped to its query in one step. It becomes fragile when a question describes its answer through several unnamed intermediates, for example a race held at a venue described only by its type, during a season identified through another event. The solver must then discover which entities and relations are involved, compare candidates and combine evidence gathered across many calls. The task becomes one of exploration.
blocks.zh: 咨询图表本身很困难。 要写入SPARQL查询,用户必须识别相关实体和属性,遵循关系方向并表达问题条件之间的结合. 自然语言界面大多将此设定为语义解析: LC- QuAD 2. 0 和 KQA 带有可执行表达式的Pro配对问题,而Wikidata Query Logs数据集(WDQL)则从真实的查询日志中得出问题-query对 [4, 5, 6]. 这个框架假设一个问题可以一步步地绘制到它的询问中. 当一个问题通过几个无名中间体描述其答案时,它变得脆弱了,例如,在一个通过另一个事件确定的赛季,在一个仅按其类型描述的地点举行的比赛。 然后,解决者必须发现涉及哪些实体和关系,比较候选人,并综合通过许多电话收集的证据。 这项任务成为探索的任务。

blocks.en: Agents that interleave reasoning with retrieval are a natural fit for this task [ 7 ] , but two obstacles limit them on knowledge graphs. The first concerns data. Training an agent to explore requires traces of exploration over tasks whose difficulty can be varied and whose answers can be checked. Recent synthetic datasets for search agents raise difficulty by obscuring entities, sampling rare seeds or dispersing evidence [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . When the evidence lives on the open web, however, it is hard to certify that a question has exactly one answer and that each of its clues is needed. A frozen knowledge graph allows both checks. The second obstacle concerns the interface. One navigation step on a hub entity can return thousands of neighbours and statements. Tool-calling agents add these results to their conversation, and long-context studies show that models miss evidence depending on its position and lose accuracy as input grows [ 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 将推理与检索交互的代理人自然适合这个任务[7],但有两个障碍使它们限制在知识图上. 第一个涉及数据。 训练一名探险员需要探险的痕迹,这些任务的困难可能各不相同,其答案可以检查。 最近用于搜索代理人的合成数据集通过模糊实体,采样稀有种子或分散证据来引起困难[15,16,17]. 然而,当证据存在于开放的网络上时,很难证明一个问题有完全一个答案,并且每个线索都需要. 一个被冻结的知识图允许两种检查. 第二个障碍是接口。 在枢纽实体上采取一个导航步骤可以使成千上万的邻居和声明返回。 工具调用代理将这些结果添加到他们的谈话中,而长文研究显示,模型丢失了证据,视其位置而定,随着输入的增加而失去准确性[8,9].

blocks.en: A third question concerns openness. The strongest agents are commercial models that hide their reasoning and whose terms restrict the use of their outputs for training. For a public resource such as Wikidata, and for the institutions that rely on it, what matters is whether open models running on modest hardware can do this work.
blocks.zh: 第三个问题涉及开放性。 最强的代理商是隐藏其推理并限制其产出用于培训的商业模型. 对于像Wikidata这样的公共资源,以及依赖它的机构,关键在于运行于适度硬件上的开放式模型是否能够完成这项工作.

blocks.en: Recursive Language Models (RLMs) offer an alternative: the model inspects an external environment through code, keeps intermediate results in persistent state and delegates the reading of selected evidence to sub-calls [ 10 ] . Prime Intellect’s nano-rlm and Prime Agent apply this approach to coding harnesses [ 11 , 12 ] . While there is a natural convergence between the concept of depth in knowledge graph exploration (through graph traversal) and recursive language model (through persistent state and sub-calls), this remains untested so far.
blocks.zh: 递归性语言模型(RLMs)提供了一个替代方案:模型通过代码检查外部环境,将中间结果保持在持久性状态并授权阅读所选证据进行分调 [10]. Prime Intellect的纳米-rlm 和 Prime Agent 将这种方法应用到编码带 [11,12]. 虽然知识图探究深度的概念(通过图轨)与递归性语言模型(通过持续状态和子调取)之间有自然的趋同,但这至今仍未被检验.

blocks.en: We formulate three hypotheses. H1 (Structure). The difficulty of a search task over a knowledge graph can be controlled through the structure of the question, meaning the number of nested dependencies to resolve and the ambiguity of each condition, provided every condition is needed to identify the answer. This would make structure a lever of difficulty alongside entity obscurity and obfuscated wording. H2 (Evidence management). On long-horizon graph search, many failures come from how a model manages retrieved evidence rather than from missing knowledge or reasoning ability. Keeping graph results in persistent program state, which the model inspects selectively, should improve accuracy with the model held fixed, mostly on multi-hop questions. H3 (Open models). In such an environment, an open-weight model served on a single GPU can match commercial models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出三个假设。 H1 (结构). 在知识图上搜索任务的难度可以通过问题的结构来控制,意思是需要解决的巢属数量和每个条件的模糊性,前提是每个条件都需要来识别答案. 这将使结构与实体模糊不清和含糊不清的措词一起成为困难的杠杆。 H2(证据管理). 在长视图搜索中,许多失败来自模型如何管理被检索出的证据,而不是缺失的知识或推理能力. 将图表结果保存在持续的程序状态中,模型有选择地检查这种状态,这应该能够提高固定模型的准确性,主要是在多跳题上。 H3(开放型号). 在这种环境中,在单一的GPU上服务的开量模型可以匹配商业模型.

blocks.en: To test these hypotheses, we make three contributions. 1. A construction method and dataset. We grow a question graph around a known answer. An LLM selects a named entity and replaces it with a bundle of conditions drawn from the graph. Code enumerates the bundles and certifies that the graph still identifies the target alone and that removing any new condition admits another target. From seeds that vary entity type, language and prominence, we retain 10,235 solving traces over single-entity questions and multi-hop questions of several answer types. 2. An environment. We release the RLM harness that produced the traces, with 13 graph functions over a frozen February 2026 Wikidata snapshot. Others can replicate and extend the traces and evaluate further models in the same environment. 3. A first evaluation. On 100 questions, we run two models under both the harness and direct tool calling over the same functions. The harness raises gpt-6-luna from 49 to 61 correct answers and Qwen3.8-27B, served on one H100 GPU, from 60 to 74. On multi-hop questions, it takes gpt-6-luna from 9 to 19 out of 50 and Qwen3.8-27B from 20 to 28.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这些假设,我们作出了三项贡献。 1. 施工方法和数据集。 我们以一个已知的答案来绘制一个问题图表。 LLM选择一个被命名的实体,取而代之的是从图中抽出的一系列条件. 代码列举了捆绑,并证明图中仍然单独识别出目标,而去除任何新条件都接纳了另一个目标. 从不同实体类型、语言和突出位置的种子中,我们保留了10 235个解决单一实体问题和多个回答类型的多跳问题。 2. 环境。 我们释放了产生痕迹的 RLM 带子, 13个图函数 在被冻结的2026年2月 Wikidata快照。 其他国家可以复制和扩大这些痕迹,并评估在同一环境中的进一步模型。 3. 第一次评价。 在100个问题中,我们运行着两个模式, 一方面是操纵工具, 一方面是直接工具, 吊带将gpt-6-luna从49个正确答案提升到61个正确答案,并使用1个H100 GPU的Qune3.8-27B,从60个到74个. 在多跳题上,gpt-6-luna从9到19分50分,Quen3.8-27B从20到28分.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Questions over knowledge graphs. LC-QuAD 2.0 generates questions paired with SPARQL queries over Wikidata and DBpedia [ 4 ] . KQA Pro adds explicit compositional programs covering relations, attributes, qualifiers and comparisons [ 5 ] , while GrailQA evaluates generalization to new combinations and unseen schema elements [ 13 ] . WDQL builds 335,000 question–query pairs from Wikidata Query Service logs: an agent cleans and validates logged queries and writes their corresponding questions [ 6 ] . These datasets provide executable supervision from templates, programs or queries written by users. KGQAGen combines LLM-based question generation over Wikidata with symbolic answer verification [ 14 ] . We use executable queries during construction and scoring, while the evaluated solver explores the graph through functions without receiving the answer query.
blocks.zh: 问取于知识图. LC-QuAD 2.0在Wikidata和DBpedia 上生成与 SPARQL 查询对等的问题. [4]. 质量保证 Pro增加了包含关系,属性,修饰和比较等内容的明确组成程序[5],而"圣杯QA"则评价对新组合的概括和看不见的"计划"元素[13]. WDQL从Wikidata Query Service日志中构建出335,000个问题-query对:一个代理清理并验证已登录的查询并写出它们相应的问题[6]. 这些数据集提供从模板,程序或用户所写的查询中可执行的监督. KGQAGen 将基于 LLM 的问题生成比Wikidata 与符号化的答案验证[14] 结合. 我们在构建和打分时使用可执行查询,而被评估的解析器通过函数来探索图表,而不会收到答案查询.

blocks.en: Synthetic questions for search agents. DeepDive constructs search questions from paths through a knowledge graph, with an LLM selecting successive nodes and obscuring identifying information [ 15 ] . WebSailor combines seed sampling, graph exploration and information obfuscation to increase uncertainty during search [ 16 ] . REDSearcher uses graph topology and evidence dispersion to guide task synthesis [ 17 ] . SearchArt describes a pipeline from seed sampling and evidence-graph construction to question writing and trajectory verification [ 18 ] . We draw on its attention to seed exposure, graph structure and domain coverage. These approaches motivate several dimensions of task complexity; our construction focuses on nested dependencies and the contribution of individual conditions to identifying a target.
blocks.zh: 搜索人员合成问题. DeepDive通过一个知识图从路径中构建搜索问题,其中LLM会选择相继的节点并模糊识别信息[15]. WebSailor将种子采样,图表探索和信息混淆结合起来,以增加搜索过程中的不确定性[16]. REDSearcher使用图表地貌和证据分散来指导任务合成[17]. 搜索 艺术描述了从种子取样和证据图构造到质疑写作和轨迹核查的管道[18]。 我们提请注意种子接触、图表结构和覆盖领域。 这些办法激发了任务复杂性的几个层面;我们的建设侧重于巢穴依赖以及个别条件对确定目标的贡献。

blocks.en: Question structure and necessary conditions. InfoSeek formulates deep research as hierarchical constraint satisfaction, combining parallel constraints with dependent sub-questions [ 19 ] . WebShaper represents information seeking through knowledge projections and set operations, then increases complexity by replacing a known entity with a sub-question [ 20 ] . We adopt this replacement as an executable graph expansion. MuSiQue composes single-hop questions into connected reasoning chains and filters examples that permit shortcuts [ 21 ] . LoHoSearch requires clues to identify one answer together and uses leave-one-out checks to test their necessity [ 22 ] . We apply these checks after each expansion: the complete graph must identify the seed alone, and removing any new condition must admit another target. These guarantees concern the frozen graph; the later natural-language question still requires a fidelity check.
blocks.zh: 问题结构和必要条件。 InfoSeek将深度研究发展为等级约束满足,将平行约束与依赖子问题相结合[19]. WebShaper代表通过知识预测和设定操作来寻求的信息,然后通过用子问题[20]来取而代之来增加复杂性. 我们采用这个替换作为可执行的图表扩展. MuSiQue将单跳题作成连接的推理链并过滤允许快捷键的例子 [21]. LoHoSearch需要线索来共同识别一个答案,并使用放行一出检查来测试其必要性[22]. 我们在每次扩展后都应用这些检查:完整的图表必须单独识别种子,而去除任何新的条件必须承认另一个目标. 这些保证涉及被冻结的图表;后来的自然语言问题仍然需要对忠诚进行核查。

blocks.en: Agents and programmatic exploration. ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions that retrieve external information [ 7 ] . Think-on-Graph guides exploration through entities and relations selected by an LLM [ 23 ] ; KG-Agent combines graph tools, an executor and knowledge memory for multi-step reasoning [ 24 ] . CodeAct uses executable Python actions to compose operations and retain intermediate results [ 25 ] . Our comparison uses the same graph functions through direct tool calling and through Python, so the main interface difference concerns how the model orchestrates calls and manages retrieved evidence. The budgets permit different numbers of graph calls, which we report alongside accuracy.
blocks.zh: 代理人和方案探索。 ReAct Interleave 推理与获取外部信息的动作 [7]. Think-on-Graph通过LLM所选择的实体和关系引导探索 [23];KG-Agent结合了图表工具,执行器和多步推理的知识内存 [24]. CodeAct使用可执行的Python动作来作曲操作并保留中间结果[25]. 我们的比较通过直接工具调用和Python使用相同的图函数,所以主要的界面差异涉及模型管弦乐团如何调用和管理被取回的证据. 预算允许不同的图表调用,我们报告这些调用和准确性。

blocks.en: Context management and RLM harnesses. Lost in the Middle documents sensitivity to the position of evidence in long contexts [ 8 ] . RULER tests retrieval, multi-hop tracing and aggregation, showing that a model’s advertised context window can exceed the length at which it handles these tasks reliably [ 9 ] . RLMs move context inspection into an external environment and let the model process selected portions through recursive calls [ 10 ] . Prime Intellect’s nano-rlm implements a minimal harness with a persistent IPython environment and recursive subagents [ 11 ] . Prime Agent extends this direction to a coding harness with persistent state and mechanisms for improvement across runs [ 12 ] . We apply RLM-style execution to knowledge-graph navigation. Our evidence-interpretation helpers receive selected data without graph access, while the main model stores and filters graph results in Python. The evaluation tests this combined interface rather than isolating the effect of recursive calls.
blocks.zh: 环境管理和 RLM 控制器。 在Middle文档中迷失了对长期证据位置的敏感性[8]. RULAR测试检索,多跳追踪和聚合,显示一个模型所广告的上下文窗口可以超过它可靠地处理这些任务的长度[9]. RLMs将上下文检查移入外部环境,让模型过程通过递归调用选择部分[10]. 首页 Intellect的纳米-rlm 执行一个最小的带带, 具有持久的IPython环境和递归子剂 [11]. Prime Agent将这一方向延伸至具有持续状态的编码工具,以及跨越[12]的改进机制。 我们把 RLM 式执行应用于知识图导航. 我们的证据解释帮助者在没有图访问的情况下接收了选定的数据,而主要模型存储并过滤出图结果为Python. 评估测试了这种综合接口,而不是隔离循环呼叫的效果。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题定义

blocks.en: We represent a question over a knowledge graph as a set of constraints on an unknown answer. Answering the question means finding the entity that satisfies all constraints together.
blocks.zh: 我们在知识图上提出一个问题,作为对未知答案的一套限制。 回答这个问题意味着找到一个能够共同满足所有制约因素的实体。

blocks.en: Representation of a question. Let G ⊆ E × P × E G\subseteq E\times P\times E be a knowledge graph, where E E is the set of entities and P P the set of properties. A fact ( u , p , v ) ∈ G (u,p,v)\in G links entity u u to entity v v through property p p ; u u and v v are neighbours .

blocks.en: A condition restricts the answer through one property and a set of entities, for example “took place at Circuit de Monaco”. Following WebShaper [ 20 ] , we write a condition as a knowledge projection . For a set of entities S ⊆ E S\subseteq E , R p ( S ) = { x ∈ E : ∃ y ∈ S , ( x , p , y ) ∈ G } R_{p}(S)=\{x\in E:\exists y\in S,\ (x,p,y)\in G\} (1) is the condition’s candidate set : the entities linked to a member of S S through p p . A condition in the opposite direction uses the reversed relation, R p − 1 ( S ) = { x ∈ E : ∃ y ∈ S , ( y , p , x ) ∈ G } R^{-1}_{p}(S)=\{x\in E:\exists y\in S,\ (y,p,x)\in G\} . An entity satisfies several conditions when it belongs to the intersection of their candidate sets.

blocks.en: The candidate count of a condition on a single entity y y is | R p ​ ( { y } ) | |R_{p}(\{y\})| : the number of entities in the whole graph that satisfy this condition alone, using the reversed projection for incoming conditions. Participation in the 24 Hours of Le Mans has a candidate count of 2,331. We use this count as a proxy for ambiguity: a condition with more candidates restricts the answer less on its own and can require the solver to combine more clues.

The target set T T contains the entities satisfying all conditions on the answer. For example, “Which race took place at Circuit de Monaco and was part of the 1986 Formula One World Championship?” gives T = R location ​ ( { Circuit de Monaco } ) ∩ R part ​ of ​ ( { 1986 season } ) , T=R_{\mathrm{location}}(\{\text{Circuit de Monaco}\})\cap R_{\mathrm{part\ of}}(\{\text{1986 season}\}), (2) where “1986 season” abbreviates the championship’s name. The first projection returns races at the venue; the second returns events of the season. We build each question around a known answer entity, the seed s s , and require T = { s } T=\{s\} .

blocks.en: Constructing long-horizon tasks. To add a dependency, we turn a named entity into a hidden one that the solver must identify through further conditions. Two operators do this. SELECT chooses which named entity of the question graph to hide next. EXPAND replaces its singleton set with a set defined by a bundle : one to three conditions describing that entity. The first, or root , expansion describes the seed itself and defines T T . Later expansions introduce the sets V 1 , V 2 , … V_{1},V_{2},\ldots of hidden intermediate entities.
blocks.zh: 构建长视距任务. 为了增加一个依赖性,我们把一个被命名的实体变成一个隐藏的实体,解决者必须通过进一步的条件来识别. 两个操作员这样做。 SELECT 选择将问题图中的哪个实体命名为下一个隐藏. EXPAND将其单子集替换为由捆绑定义的集: 描述该实体的一到三个条件. 第一个,或root. 扩展描述种子本身并定义了T T. 后来的扩展引入了 V 1, V 2, ... V_{ 1}, V_{ 2}, 隐藏的中间实体 。

EXPAND describes the venue through its type and sport: V 1 \displaystyle V_{1} = R instance ​ of ​ ( { street circuit } ) ∩ R sport ​ ( { auto racing } ) , \displaystyle=R_{\mathrm{instance\ of}}(\{\text{street circuit}\})\cap R_{\mathrm{sport}}(\{\text{auto racing}\}), (3) T \displaystyle T = R location ​ ( V 1 ) ∩ R part ​ of ​ ( { 1986 season } ) . \displaystyle=R_{\mathrm{location}}(V_{1})\cap R_{\mathrm{part\ of}}(\{\text{1986 season}\}). (4) The two-condition bundle defines V 1 V_{1} , the candidate venues. The question now describes the race through a venue it does not name. Repeating SELECT and EXPAND adds nested dependencies to create a long-horizon task.

EXPAND通过它的类型和运动来描述场地: V 1\ displaystyle V\\ 1} = R 实例 ({ 街道电路} ) \\ R 运动( {汽车赛事} ),\ displaystyle=R\ mathrm{ instance\ of }(\ text{街道电路}}\ cap R\ mathrm{ sport} (\ text{ auto racing}), (3) T\Displaytyle T = R 位置 (V 1) QQ R 部分 ({1986赛季}). 。 。 。 。 \ displaystyle=R_{\- mathrm{ location} (V_{- {}})\ cap R_{\- mathrm{ part\ (\\ text{ 1986 季}}). For a proposed bundle B B , let T B T_{B} be the target set after the expansion, and T B ∖ { c } T_{B\setminus\{c\}} the target set after removing condition c c from the bundle while keeping the rest of the question graph. Following LoHoSearch [ 22 ] , we check necessity when adding a bundle. We also reject clues that reveal hidden names, including given-name and family-name clues, and require each condition to match at least two candidates so that no single condition identifies the entity alone.

blocks.en: Graph representation. We give the question graph to the LLM as a Mermaid-like text. Named entities are nodes with readable labels, hidden entities are variable nodes, and conditions are directed edges labelled with their property. The variable ?target stands for the answer, and ?v1 , ?v2 , and so on for the hidden intermediate entities V 1 , V 2 , … V_{1},V_{2},\ldots . After the expansion above, the Monaco question graph reads: ⬇ ? target -- location --> ? v1 ? target -- part of --> 1986 Formula One World Championship ? v1 -- instance of --> street circuit ? v1 -- sport --> auto racing Repeated variables denote the same entity. The LLM reads the dependencies from this text; code keeps the underlying entity and property identifiers to query the graph.

blocks.en: We use a frozen Wikidata snapshot from February 2026, with about 48 million entities (Wikidata items) and 262 million facts between them.
blocks.zh: 我们使用从2026年2月起被冻结的Wikidata快照,其中大约有4800万个实体(Wikidata项目)和它们之间的2.62亿个事实.

blocks.en: 3.2 Seed selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 种子选择

blocks.en: We select seeds to vary entity types, languages and prominence. We include less prominent entities to reduce reliance on answers a model may have memorized, while keeping entities with enough facts to build a question graph. We exclude Wikimedia maintenance entities (categories, templates and disambiguation pages) and entities with more than 500 incoming or 100 outgoing links. Each seed must have at least one sitelink, providing a linked Wikimedia page, and belong to a common class, such as human . We then require an initial bundle that passes certification and necessity.
blocks.zh: 我们选择种子来改变实体的类型、语言和突出性。 我们把不太突出的实体包括在内,以减少对一个模型可能已经记住的答案的依赖,同时使实体有足够的事实来构建一个问题图表。 我们排除了Wikimedia维护实体(类别,模板和分化页面)以及超过500个或100个出入口链接的实体. 每个种子必须至少有一个站点链接,提供链接的维基媒体页面,并属于人类等共同类. . 然后,我们需要一个初步的包裹,通过认证和必要性。

blocks.en: We reserve a share of seeds described only in Arabic, Russian or Chinese to vary language coverage. To balance prominence, we use the long-tail score L ⁡ ( e ) = 1 − r ⁡ ( d in ​ ( e ) ) + r ⁡ ( q ⁡ ( e ) ) 2 , L(e)=\frac{1-r(d_{\mathrm{in}}(e))+r(q(e))}{2}, (7) where r r is the percentile midrank among eligible entities, d in ​ ( e ) d_{\mathrm{in}}(e) the incoming degree and q ⁡ ( e ) q(e) the numeric part of the QID. Low incoming degree and a higher QID number increase the score. We sample across popular ( L ⁡ ( e ) < .33 L(e)<.33 ), moderate ( L ⁡ ( e ) ∈ [ .33 , .66 ) L(e)\in[.33,.66) ) and rare ( L ⁡ ( e ) ≥ .66 L(e)\geq.66 ) seeds. We selected 2,973 seeds and attempted generation from 2,160 of them. Appendix A reports the studies used to assess whether a seed supports continued growth.

blocks.en: 3.3 Growing the question graph
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 问世图

blocks.en: Figure 1: Graph growth through SELECT and EXPAND. Successive panels show how the same target remains identifiable as named entities become variables and the graph expands. The final Monaco graph contains 16 relations after ten expansions.
blocks.zh: 图1:通过SELECT和EXPAND绘制增长图。 相继的面板显示,在被命名的实体成为变量和图表扩展时,同一目标仍然可以识别. 最后的摩纳哥图包括了十次扩张后的16个关系.

blocks.en: We use an LLM to choose entities and bundles that form a coherent question from the verified candidates. Both prompts include the current graph and a working question , a natural-language rendering of its conditions that anchors the model’s choices. Figure 1 shows successive expansions of the Monaco example.
blocks.zh: 我们使用LLM来选择实体和捆绑,从经核实的候选人中形成一个连贯的问题. 两个提示都包含当前图表和一个工作问题, 自然地用语言渲染其条件, 图1显示摩纳哥的例子不断扩展。

blocks.en: SELECT. We retain named entities with a label, a description, at most 20,000 incoming and 2,000 outgoing links, and at least two usable conditions: incoming or outgoing relations around the entity that pass filtering. We exclude entities used only as classes, the objects of instance-of or subclass-of conditions. We also check entity necessity : replacing the name with an unconstrained variable must admit another target answer. This applies the necessity principle of Section 3.1 to the selected entity; later expansions can make an earlier name redundant.
blocks.zh: 自我检查。 我们保留有标签、描述、最多20 000个接通和2 000个接通的点名实体以及至少两个可用的条件:接通或接通通过过滤的实体。 我们排除了仅作为类别、条件实例或次类别对象的实体。 我们还检查实体必要性:用一个不受约束的变量替换名称必须承认另一个目标答案。 这对选定的实体适用了第3.1节的必要性原则;以后的扩展可以使更早的名字变得多余.

blocks.en: For each remaining entity, we give the LLM a card containing its label, types, up to three descriptions and a relation profile. The profile groups usable conditions by direction and neighbour type, with counts per property, so the LLM can judge how to describe the entity. The LLM receives at most 20 cards and returns a candidate identifier with a reason, or rejects all candidates.
blocks.zh: 对于每个剩下的实体,我们给LLM一张卡片,里面有它的标签,类型,最多三个描述和一个关系简介. 剖面图组按方向和相邻类型可以使用条件,每个属性都有计数,因此LLM可以判断如何描述实体. LLM最多收到20张卡片,并返回一个有原因的候选标识,或者拒绝所有候选.

blocks.en: EXPAND. We enumerate bundles of one to three conditions and use SPARQL to retain those passing certification and necessity (Section 3.1 ). We rank them by decreasing size to add more joint constraints, then by decreasing sum of candidate counts within each size. This favours broader individual clues that require the solver to combine conditions.
blocks.zh: 离开。 我们列举了一至三个条件的组合,并利用SPARQL保留那些通过认证和必要性(第3.1节)。 我们通过缩小规模,增加共同制约,然后通过减少每个规模内候选人人数的总和,来划分它们的等级。 这有利于更广泛的单个线索,要求解题者结合条件.

blocks.en: The LLM receives up to 50 ranked bundles, each listing its conditions and candidate counts, together with the question graph, working question and selected entity’s label and description. The selected entity appears as ?x . The LLM chooses a bundle and rewrites the working question to express the updated graph. It returns a bundle identifier, a reason and the new working question without adding or editing conditions.
blocks.zh: LLM收到多达50个排名的捆绑,每个捆绑列出其条件和候选人计数,以及问题图表,工作问题和被选实体的标签和说明. 选定的实体为 ?x 。 LLM选择捆绑并重写工作问题以表达更新的图表. 它在不添加或编辑条件的情况下返回捆绑的标识符,理由和新的工作问题.

blocks.en: Stopping criterion. We repeat SELECT and EXPAND, counting the root as the first expansion. We require at least three expansions and depth three, with limits of ten expansions and depth seven. Depth is the longest shortest-path distance from the target to a named entity, reading edges in both directions. We chose these structural thresholds empirically; Appendix B gives implementation details.
blocks.zh: 停止标准。 我们重复SELECT和EXPAND,把根算作第一次扩张. 我们至少需要三次扩张和深度三,限制十次扩张和深度七. 深度是从目标到被命名的实体最短最短的路径距离,读取双向边缘. 我们实证地选择了这些结构阈值;附录B提供了执行的细节。

blocks.en: 3.4 From graph to question
blocks.zh: 3.4 从图表到问题

blocks.en: After growth, we vary what to ask about the identified target (Table 1 ) and read the expected answer from the graph or entity record. Sampling targets are 60% identity, 20% year, 10% quantity and 10% shared across group, count, argmax and argmin. Filtering changes the observed proportions.
blocks.zh: 在成长后,我们可就所确定的目标提出不同的要求(表1),并从图表或实体记录中读取预期的答案。 抽样目标是60%的身份、20%的年份、10%的数量和10%在群体、计数、argmax和argmin之间分享。 过滤会改变观察到的比例 。

blocks.en: Table 1: Multi-hop question types. Illustrative question endings after a description identifying a race. Group tasks use participation links; extrema compare participants’ dates of birth.
blocks.zh: 表1:多跳题类型. 说明性问题在描述识别出种族后结束. 团队任务使用参与链接;extrema比较参与者的出生日期。

blocks.en: A writer LLM turns the question graph into a question, in the voice of a persona drawn from Nemotron-Personas-USA and in a register set by the persona’s education. Mechanical checks reject questions that contain an identifier, the name of a hidden entity or the answer. A critic LLM checks that the question states every condition, asks for the right answer and reads naturally. Appendix C gives the writer and critic instructions.
blocks.zh: 作者LLM将问题图变成一个问题, 机械检查拒绝包含识别符,隐藏实体名称或答案的问题. 一位评论家LLM检查,问题说明每个条件,要求正确答案,自然读取. 附 录 C给出了作家和评论家的指示.

blocks.en: From 2,003 certified question graphs we accepted 1,498 questions, including 227 with a wording-only waiver that preserves the fidelity and answer checks. A later pass rewrote question openings, with a second LLM checking each rewrite; it changed 1,443 of the 1,498 questions and removed none.
blocks.zh: 从2 003个经认证的问题图表中,我们接受了1 498个问题,包括227个只保留忠诚和回答检查的措辞豁免问题。 一个后传重写出的问题开口,第二个LLM检查每个重写;它修改了1,498个问题中的1,443个,没有去掉.

blocks.en: We also generate single-entity questions , which name the target and ask about a selected fact without growing a question graph. They use the same writer and mechanical checks, without a critic. The batch contains 11,130 accepted questions over 4,427 entities.
blocks.zh: 我们还产生单一实体问题, 给目标取名, 他们使用相同的作家和机械支票,没有批评者. 该批共涉及4 427个实体的11 130个接受问题。

blocks.en: 3.5 Solving traces and retention
blocks.zh: 3.5 解决痕迹和保留

blocks.en: A solving trace records a model answering a question in the RLM harness (Section 4.1 ). During collection, we provide graph-derived clues to help the model navigate towards the answer and obtain successful traces for future training. Gemini-3.1-flash-lite runs at temperature zero, without thinking and within 30 turns. We retain traces whose final answer matches the expected answer and remove the collection clues from the exported prompt. Table 2 gives the counts; Appendix D summarizes the instructions.
blocks.zh: 解决跟踪记录了一个模型,它回答了RLM带中的一个问题(第4.1节)。 在收集过程中,我们提供出自图表的线索来帮助模型向答案方向走去,并为今后的培训获得成功的痕迹. 双子座-3.1-快闪-立特在零温下运行,没有思考,在30个转弯之内. 我们保留了那些最终答案与预期答案相符的痕迹,并从输出的快取出收集线索. 表2列出了计算结果;附录D概述了说明。

blocks.en: Table 2: Generation and retention counts. Single-entity generation starts from selected facts. Each example counts once despite revisions or retries.
blocks.zh: 表2:生成和保留数。 单一实体的生成起源于选定的事实。 每一个例子都算数一次,尽管有修改或重复。

blocks.en: Trace acceptance removes 552 of 1,224 attempted multi-hop questions and 1,567 of 11,130 single-entity questions. The released corpus contains 10,235 traces, with a median length of ten turns for multi-hop and one for single-entity questions. Cleaning removes 10,042 error turns and keeps 3,624; these count turns, not lost questions.
blocks.zh: 跟踪接收删除了1 224个尝试多跳题中的552个和11 130个单实体题中的1 567个。 释放的教程有10,235个痕迹,中间长度为多跳10个转弯,单实体问题1个转弯. 清理清除出10,042个出错转弯并保留了3,624个;这些倒数转弯,而不是丢失的问题.

blocks.en: These reductions measure lost questions. They do not measure what information is lost between the question graph and its written question: the critic checks fidelity, but the batch has no human estimate of that loss. Trace filtering also shifts the distribution of question types, because the solving model completes some types more often than others.
blocks.zh: 这些削减措施失去了问题。 它们没有衡量问题图和书面问题之间损失的信息:评论家检查忠诚度,但批次没有关于损失的人类估计。 追踪过滤也改变了问题类型的分布,因为解析模型比其他类型更经常地完成一些类型.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: The evaluation checks that the harness used to produce the traces is a useful environment for solving the questions. It asks whether the harness helps a model compared with calling the same graph functions directly, and how far it takes an open-weight model served on a single GPU. These two questions correspond to H2 and H3 (Section 1 ); the comparison between single-entity and multi-hop questions also bears indirectly on H1.
blocks.zh: 评价检查了用来制造痕迹的绳子是解决问题的有用环境。 它询问,与直接调用同一图表功能相比,这个牵引装置是否有助于模型,在单一的GPU上服务一个开量模型需要多少时间. 这两个问题与H2和H3相对应(第1节);单实体和多跳问题的比较也间接地影响了H1.

blocks.en: 4.1 Harness and protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 协调和协议

blocks.en: We compare two interfaces to the same 13 graph functions (Table 3 ). The RLM harness gives the model a persistent Python REPL, where it can combine function calls, filter results and store intermediate data in variables. The tool-calling agent receives the functions as tools and their outputs as conversation messages. We implement this baseline with the OpenAI Agents SDK, using its native OpenAI integration and LiteLLM for the other providers.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两个接口与相同的13个图表函数(表3.). RLM带使模型具有持久性Python REPL,可以将函数调用,过滤结果并存储在变量中的中间数据. 工具调用代理接收作为工具的功能,其输出作为对话信息. 我们与OpenAI Agents SDK一起实施这一基线,使用其原生OpenAI集成和LiteLLM为其他供应商服务.

blocks.en: Table 3: Graph functions shared by both evaluation interfaces. The six languages are English, French, German, Chinese, Arabic and Russian.
blocks.zh: 表3:两个评价界面共享的图表功能。 这六种语言是英语、法语、德语、中文、阿拉伯语和俄语。

blocks.en: The RLM also provides llm_query(text, instruction) to interpret supplied evidence through a model sub-call, and llm_map(items, instruction) to batch such requests and return an answer per item. These helpers have no graph access. The RLM submits its answer through FINAL(value) or FINAL_VAR(value) ; the agent returns structured output in the requested answer format. Both interfaces refuse graph calls using identifiers absent from the question and earlier results.
blocks.zh: RLM还提供llm_query(文本,指令),通过模型子调用来解释所提供的证据,并提供llm_map(项目,指令)来批量此类请求并返回每个项目的答复. 这些帮助者没有图表访问权限. RLM 通过 Finally( value) 或 Finally_ VAR( value) 提交答案; 代理以请求的答案格式返回结构化输出 。 两种界面都使用问题和更早的结果所没有的标识符拒绝图召.

blocks.en: We use low reasoning effort for all models in the main evaluation. Agents allow up to 100 model calls and a $0.50 cost cap per question, which does not apply to the locally served Qwen3.8-27B; RLM runs allow up to 100 turns and 80 sub-calls. Both interfaces truncate visible outputs at 10,000 characters. These limits do not equalize graph calls: a Python cell can execute many graph calls. The shared instruction tells models that the question has an answer and to continue until they find it.
blocks.zh: 在主要评价中,我们对所有模型都采用低推理方法。 代理允许最多100个型号呼叫和每问题0.50个费用上限,这不适用于当地服务的Quen3.8-27B;RLM运行允许最多100个转接和80个分拨. 两个接口都以一万个字符将可见输出截取出. 这些限制并不等于图调:一个Python单元格可以执行许多图调. 共同的指令告诉模型,问题有答案,并持续到找到为止.

blocks.en: The main evaluation contains 50 single-entity and 50 multi-hop questions built with the pipeline of Section 3 . Evaluated models receive no collection clues.
blocks.zh: 主要评价包括50个单一实体和50个用第3节管道建造的多跳问题。 被评价的模型没有收到收集线索.

blocks.en: We ran gpt-6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B under both interfaces, which measures the effect of the harness for each of them. GLM-5.3-flash and Gemini-3.1-flash-lite ran only as tool-calling agents. Qwen3.8-27B runs in FP8 with vLLM on one H100 GPU, with thinking enabled at low effort, temperature 1 and up to 8,192 output tokens per reply, under both interfaces. As an agent it uses vLLM’s tool-call parser and returns its answer through an answer tool, because the server cannot combine tool calls with a constrained output format. gpt-6-luna and the other agents run through their providers’ APIs.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个接口下运行了gpt-6-luna和Qwen3.8-27B,它们分别测量了被拉带的效果. GLM-5.3-flash和双子座-3.1-flash-lite只作为工具调用代理跑出. Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B在FP8中运行,用vLLM在一个H100 GPU上,在低功耗下可以进行思维,温度1,每个回放下最多8,192个输出令牌,在两个接口下. 作为一个代理,它使用vLLM的工具调用解析器,并通过一个解答工具返回它的答案,因为服务器不能将工具调用与受限制的输出格式结合起来. gpt-6-luna和其他代理通过其供应商的API运行.

blocks.en: Using an open-weight model also matters for the corpus. Commercial frontier models such as gpt-6-luna reason internally and return only their final reply, whereas Qwen3.8-27B returns its full reasoning, which the harness records beside the code, outputs and graph calls of each turn. Traces generated with an open model can therefore include the reasoning behind each action, for training and auditing, and can be produced locally without per-token costs or provider terms restricting their use for training.
blocks.zh: 使用开放式的模型对人体免疫机能丧失综合症也很重要。 gpt-6-luna等商业前沿模型在内部解释,只返回最后答复,而Quen3.8-27B则返回其全部推理,这些逻辑记录在每一回合的代码、输出和图表调用之外。 因此,使用开放模式生成的追踪可以包括每项行动背后的推理,用于培训和审计,并且可以在当地制作,而无需支付每笔费用或提供商条款限制其用于培训。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 4: Main evaluation results and execution patterns, ordered by total accuracy. gpt-6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B ran under both interfaces. Target reached counts runs whose graph calls touched the target entity, whether or not the final answer was correct. Graph calls are rounded means per run; tokens are median input plus output tokens per run. Repeats use a function and arguments already called in the same run; no answer counts runs that ended without a final answer: at the turn or cost limit or, for the eight Qwen3.8-27B agent runs, with an empty reply. ∗ Qwen costs estimate batched serving on one H100 through Google Colab; API costs use token prices.
blocks.zh: 表4:主要评价结果和执行模式,按完全准确排序。 gpt-6-luna和Quen3.8-27B在两个接口下运行. 目标到达的计数会运行其图表通话触及目标实体,无论最终答案是否正确. 图调为每跑的四舍五入值;符为中位输入加输出符. 重复使用同一运行中已经调用的函数和参数;没有结束的答案计数运行没有最终的答案:在转弯或成本限制下,或者,对于8个Quen3.8-27B代理运行,有空回放. 页:1 Quen成本估计通过Google Colab分批售出1个H100;API成本使用象征性价格.

blocks.en: The harness improves results. The two best results both come from the RLM harness (Table 4 ), and it improves both models we ran under both interfaces. gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers and Qwen3.8-27B from 60 to 74. For gpt-6-luna the gain is almost entirely on multi-hop questions, 19 against 9; for Qwen3.8-27B it is 28 against 20 on multi-hop questions and 46 against 40 on single-entity ones. On multi-hop questions, the harness also takes each model to the target entity more often: 35 runs against 17 for gpt-6-luna, 39 against 27 for Qwen3.8-27B. Once there, each model answers correctly at about the same rate under both interfaces, about one half for gpt-6-luna and three quarters for Qwen3.8-27B. The harness therefore helps by carrying the search further through the chain of conditions. It also brings an open model to a useful level: served on a single GPU at an estimated $0.04 per question, Qwen3.8-27B answers most of the questions.
blocks.zh: 绳子能提高效果。 两个最佳结果都来自RLM带(表4),它改进了我们在两个界面下运行的两个模型. gpt-6-luna从49个到61个正确答案,而Qune3.8-27B从60个到74个. 对于gpt-6-luna,收益几乎完全来自多跳题,19对9;对于Qune3.8-27B. 这是28对20的多跳问题,46对40的单实体问题。 在多跳题上,吊带还更经常地将每个型号带到目标实体:35跑出17跑出gpt-6-luna,39跑出27跑出Qwen3.8-27B. 到达后,每个模型在两个接口下以大约相同的速度正确回答,Gpt-6-luna大约为一半,Qune3.8-27B大约为四分之三. 因此,这种手段有助于通过各种条件进一步搜索。 它还将一个开放的模型带到一个有用的水平上:在一个单个GPU上服务,每个问题约0.04美元,Qune3.8-27B回答了大多数问题.

blocks.en: Where the gain comes from. Code lets the model explore broadly without placing each result in its context. This is the core principle of an RLM: the model treats the graph as an external environment, explores it from code and keeps intermediate results in persistent state, so its context holds only what it chooses to print. Through the harness, gpt-6-luna makes 15,575 graph calls per multi-hop run against 13 as an agent, at similar token use (75,255 against 65,726), and Qwen3.8-27B makes 620 against 45. Zhang et al. observe that this REPL environment alone captures much of an RLM’s benefit, with recursive sub-calls adding value on information-dense tasks [ 10 ] . Qwen3.8-27B persists longer, with a median of 24 turns and 298,059 tokens per multi-hop question against 13 turns and 75,255 tokens for gpt-6-luna. Among the agents, GLM-5.3-flash and Gemini-3.1-flash-lite exhaust their turn or cost limits in 16 and 20 multi-hop runs, Qwen3.8-27B ends 8 runs with an empty reply, and gpt-6-luna always answers, after a median of 12 calls.
blocks.zh: 所得所出之处. 代码让模型进行广泛的探索,而不将每个结果放在其上下文中. 这是RLM的核心原理:模型将图作为外部环境对待,从代码中探索,并将中间结果保持持续状态,因此其上下文只持有它选择的打印内容. Gpt-6-luna通过这把吊带,每多跳就发出15,575个图调,13个作为代理,同样使用(75,255个对65,726个),而Quen3.8-27B则620对45个. 张等. 观察到,仅这种REPL环境就能够捕捉到RLM的许多好处,而递归子调值会增加信息密集任务的价值[10]. Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B持续时间更长,每多跳题的中位数为24个转会和298 059个道具,对13个道具和75 255个道具为gpt-6-luna. 在代理商中,GLM-5.3-flash和双子座-3.1-flash-lite在16和20个多跳跑中耗尽了他们的转会或成本限制,Quen3.8-27B以空回发结束8跑,而gpt-6-luna总是在12个接通的中位数后回答.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Training smaller models. The traces are meant for training. The next step is to fine-tune a smaller open model, around 12B parameters, on them, with one sample per harness turn as in Zhang et al., where training Qwen3-8B on 1,000 filtered trajectories improved it by a median 28.3% [ 10 ] . Evaluating it in the same harness, against its base model, would test whether the traces make a model smaller than 27B usable on these questions, extending H3 to smaller models. The traces follow graph-derived clues (Section 3.5 ), so they show more direct routes than an unguided solver would take. They were collected without thinking; generating further traces with an open model in the same harness would add its full reasoning to each turn.
blocks.zh: 培训较小的模型。 痕迹是用来训练的 下一步是微调一个更小的开放式模型,大约在12B参数上,每把绳子转动一个样本,如张等,在1000个被过滤出轨迹上的Quen3-8B训练改进了中位数28.3% [10]. 对照其基准模型,用同样的绳索来评价它,将检验其痕迹是否使一个模型小于27B,可用于这些问题,从而将H3扩展到更小的模型. 痕迹遵循了由图表产生的线索(第3.5节),因此它们显示的路线比无制导的解析器要更直接. 它们是在没有思考的情况下收集的;在同一个带子上用一个开放的模型产生出更多的痕迹,将会为每个转弯增加充分的理由。

blocks.en: Evaluation scope. These first results point in a consistent direction: with the model held fixed, the harness improves accuracy for both models we ran under both interfaces, and it lets an open-weight model served on one GPU answer most of the questions. Broader testing would confirm this direction. Running GLM-5.3-flash and Gemini-3.1-flash-lite in the harness as well, and repeating runs on a larger question set, would show how far the gain extends across models. Matching graph-call budgets and enabling or disabling the sub-call helpers would show which parts of the harness contribute most.
blocks.zh: 评价范围。 这些最初的结果指向一个一致的方向:随着模型的被固定下来,这个被操纵的装置提高了我们在两个接口下运行的两个模型的精度,它让一个开量模型服务于一个GPU回答大多数问题. 更广泛的测试将证实这个方向。 运行GLM-5.3-flash和双子座-3.1-flash-lite 以及运行在更大的问题集上,将显示收益在模型中延伸了多远. 匹配图表调用预算,使次级调用帮助者能够或使其丧失能力,将显示哪些部分的调用贡献最大。

blocks.en: Training data. We generated solving traces with graph-derived clues to the solution path in the model’s prompt to help it reach the answer (Section 3.5 ). The published prompts omit these clues, but collection favours direct routes with few dead ends. Each question graph also identifies one target, and each question has a fixed expected answer. The dataset therefore provides no examples that teach a model to report several valid targets or no answer.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 在模型的快速中,我们用图表给出的解道线索生成了解道痕迹,以帮助解道(第3.5节)。 已公布的提示省略了这些线索,但收藏倾向于直接的路线,很少有死端. 每个问题图还确定了一个目标,每个问题都有固定的预期答案. 因此,数据集没有提供教一个模型报告几个有效目标或没有答案的例子.

blocks.en: We can create adversarial questions by relaxing or altering constraints to obtain graphs with multiple solutions or none. Once certification finds at least two targets, we would retrieve the complete answer set for exact scoring and ask the model to return all targets or flag ambiguity. For verified empty sets, we would require NO ANSWER . These tasks also require changing the instruction that every question has an answer.
blocks.zh: 我们可以通过放松或改变限制来创造对抗性的问题,以获得有多种解决办法或没有解决办法的图表。 一旦认证找到至少两个目标,我们就会取回精确分数的完整答案集,并要求模型返回所有目标或旗帜模糊. 对于已核实的空位,我们不需要任何答复。 这些任务还要求改变每个问题都有答案的指令.

blocks.en: Our representation combines constraints through intersections. Extending it to unions, exclusions and other logical structures could broaden the reasoning tasks while preserving executable queries and exact answer checks.
blocks.zh: 我们的代表权通过交叉而将各种限制结合在一起。 将其扩展至结合、排除和其他逻辑结构可以扩大推理任务,同时保留可执行的查询和准确的回答核对。

blocks.en: Harness. We should also improve the harness by reusing graph results, detecting repeated searches without progress and requiring answer verification before stopping. Batched helper calls and concise evidence summaries can control context growth. We would evaluate these changes with matched budgets, measuring accuracy, graph calls, tokens and stopping behaviour on tasks of varying difficulty.
blocks.zh: 调和。 我们还应当通过重新使用图表结果、检测没有进展的重复搜索和在停止前要求核实答案来改进利用情况。 断接辅助电话和简明的证据摘要可以控制上下文的增长。 我们将用相应的预算评估这些变化,衡量准确性、图表调用、标志和停止对各种困难任务的行为。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We started from a tension between two ways of accessing factual knowledge. Language models answer fluently from memory but least reliably on less prominent entities. A knowledge graph holds explicit, sourced statements that only structured queries can reach. We studied agents that answer by exploring Wikidata and identified two obstacles: the lack of training data recording exploration, and interfaces that flood the model’s context with graph results. To address them, we released 10,235 solving traces built by growing certified question graphs around fixed answers, together with the RLM harness that produced them.
blocks.zh: 我们从获得事实知识的两种方式之间的紧张关系开始。 语言模型从记忆中流利地回答,但对不太突出的实体最不可靠. 一个知识图有明确的,来源化的语句,只有结构化的查询才能到达. 我们研究了通过探索Wikidata来回答问题的代理人,并找出了两个障碍:缺乏培训数据记录探索,以及将模型的背景与图表结果相接。 为了解决这些问题,我们发布了10,235个解决痕迹,这些痕迹是通过围绕固定答案的不断增长的认证问题图表以及产生这些答案的RLM带所构建的。

blocks.en: Our evidence bears unevenly on the three hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 我们的证据在三种假设上是不均衡的。

blocks.en: H1 (structure). Certification and necessity give a checkable way to grow questions whose conditions must all be used. Multi-hop questions are markedly harder than single-entity ones in every configuration we tested: 9 to 28 correct out of 50, against 31 to 46. This gap also reflects other differences between the two sets, so it does not yet show that difficulty follows the depth or number of expansions. Showing that requires an analysis by graph structure and a human estimate of how faithfully written questions preserve their graphs.
blocks.zh: H1 (结构). 认证和必要性提供了一种可核查的方法来增加必须全部使用其条件的问题。 我们测试的每个配置中,多跳题明显比单实体问题更难:50个组合中9至28个正确,而31至46个组合. 这一差距也反映了两套间的其他差异,因此还没有显示难度跟随了扩展的深度或次数. 显示这一点需要通过图表结构进行分析,以及人类对如何忠实保存其图表的书面问题的估计.

blocks.en: H2 (evidence management). With the model held fixed, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces: gpt-6-luna from 49 to 61 and Qwen3.8-27B from 60 to 74. On multi-hop questions it doubles gpt-6-luna’s accuracy (9 to 19 out of 50) and raises Qwen3.8-27B’s from 20 to 28, while each model reaches the target entity more often (17 to 35 and 27 to 39). Once the target is reached, each model’s share of correct answers stays about the same under both interfaces. The gain therefore comes from carrying the search further, not from better interpretation at the end. This is consistent with evidence management, rather than the model, limiting long-horizon search; it holds for two models, under unmatched graph-call budgets.
blocks.zh: H2(证据管理). 随着模型被固定,这把管子改进了我们在两个接口下运行的两个模型:gpt-6-luna从49到61,Qune3.8-27B从60到74. 在多跳题上,它将gpt-6-luna的精度翻了一番(50分之9至19),将Qune3.8-27B的精度从20到28,而每个模型更经常地到达目标实体(17到35分和27到39分). 一旦目标被达到,每个模型正确答案的比例在两个界面下都大致保持不变. 因此,收益来自更深入地进行搜索,而不是最终得到更好的解释。 这与证据管理一致,而不是模型,它限制了长距离搜索;它持有两种模型,在无与伦比的图表调用预算之下。

blocks.en: H3 (open models). An open-weight model served on a single GPU gives the highest score of the evaluation, 74 out of 100, and scores above gpt-6-luna under both interfaces: 74 against 61 in the harness, 60 against 49 as an agent. Whether the traces pass this ability on to smaller models remains untested.
blocks.zh: H3(开放型号). 一个在单个GPU上服务的开量模型给出了评价的最高分,在100分中为74分,在两个界面下为gpt-6-luna以上的分数:在牵引器中为74分对61分,作为代理商为60分对49分. 痕迹是否将这种能力传给较小的模型,仍然没有经过测试.

blocks.en: These results suggest that, for structured public knowledge, part of the capability lies in the environment around the model: in how it is allowed to explore, store and verify. This matters for infrastructures such as Wikidata, where answers should be traceable to statements and their sources, and where institutions and researchers need tools they can run, inspect and adapt. We release the traces, the construction method and the harness for this purpose.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,对于结构化的公共知识而言,部分能力在于模型周围的环境:如何允许其探索、储存和核实。 这对Wikidata等基础设施很重要,在这些基础设施中,答案应可追溯到声明及其来源,而机构和研究人员需要工具,可以运行、检查和调整。 我们为此释放出痕迹,建造方法以及绳索.

blocks.en: The next steps follow from the open hypotheses: training smaller open models on the traces and evaluating them in the same harness, analysing accuracy by graph structure, adding questions with several valid answers or none, and comparing interfaces with matched budgets, with sub-calls enabled and disabled.
blocks.zh: 接下来的步骤取自开放的假设:对较小的开放模型进行关于痕迹的培训并用同一种活套对其进行评价,按照图表结构分析精度,增加几个有效答案或没有答案的问题,以及比较接口与相匹配的预算,并启用和禁用子调用.

blocks.en: More broadly, our future work aims to investigate Recursive Language Models as a generalized approach for semantic data search beyond Wikidata. Interaction between different sources and ontologies (or "database federation") has long been a leading premises of semantic web and advanced knowledge management, constantly undermined by data frictions and high associated maintenance costs. Already back in 2001, Berners-Lee and colleagues predicted that "the Semantic Web will bring structure to the meaningful content of Web pages, creating an environment where software agents roaming from page to page can readily carry out sophisticated tasks for users” [ 26 ] . Different forms of agents, based on generative AI, finally took hold of the web. And yet, building the proper interactive surface and internal capabilities to properly deal with the complexity of data remain still to this day an open program.
blocks.zh: 更广义地说,我们未来的工作旨在调查递归语言模型,将其作为维基数据以外的语义数据搜索的通俗方法. 不同来源和本体学(或"数据库联合会")之间的相互作用长期以来一直是语义网络和先进知识管理的主要前提,不断被数据摩擦和高额的相关维护成本所破坏. 早在2001年,Berners-Lee和同僚们就预测"语义网将把结构带入网页有意义的内容,创造一个从网页到网页的软件代理可以随时为用户执行复杂任务的环境" [26]. 不同形式的物剂,基于基因AI,最终掌握了网络. 然而,建立适当的互动的表面和内部能力,以适当处理数据的复杂性,至今仍是一个开放的程序。

blocks.en: Appendix A Seed-selection studies
blocks.zh: 附录A 种子选取研究

blocks.en: We tested which seed measures predict successful graph growth. The first study used 50 seeds with three runs per seed; success meant that at least one run reached three expansions and depth three. We replayed the trajectories to inspect where growth stopped. The second study used 100 seeds (33 popular, 34 moderate and 33 rare), with one run per seed and the same stopping criterion.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了哪些种子测量能预测成功的图象增长. 第一次研究使用了50个种子,每个种子有3个跑道;成功意味着至少1个跑道达到3个扩展道和3个深度道. 我们重放轨迹 检查生长停止的地方 第二项研究使用了100个种子(受欢迎的33个,中度的34个和稀有的33个),每个种子有1个跑跑和相同的停止标准.

blocks.en: Measures and results. A usable entity passes SELECT filtering and has a valid expansion bundle. A describable neighbour has a valid bundle; a usable condition is an incoming or outgoing relation retained after filtering. AUC measures how often a score ranks a successful seed above a failed seed, with half credit for ties: .5 is chance ranking and 1 is perfect separation. Table 5 gives AUCs and the reported 95% intervals. The two studies use different success endpoints, so their values describe separate probes.
blocks.zh: 措施和结果。 一个可用实体通过SELECT过滤,并有一个有效的扩展捆绑. 可拆分的相邻有有效的捆绑;可使用的条件为过滤后保留入出关系. AUC衡量一个分数将一个成功的种子排在一个失败的种子上方的分数,联系的分数是一半: 5是机会排名,1是完美的分离. 表5列出了澳大利亚联合自卫军和报告的95%的间隔。 两项研究使用不同的成功端点,因此其数值描述了独立的探测器.

blocks.en: Table 5: Seed-level growth predictors. The first row uses the accepted root expansion; root-bundle and chain measures can be computed before a run. A dash indicates a measure not reported in that study.
blocks.zh: 表5:种子一级生长预测器。 第一行使用被接受的根扩展;在跑出前可以计算出根分和链度量. 一个破折号表示该项研究未报告的措施。

blocks.en: The ability to continue after the root was more informative than the number of available clues. In the trajectory study, none of the 70 runs with no usable entity after the root succeeded. In the 100-seed study, 13 of 21 failed runs had no usable entity after the root, while no successful run had this problem. These results motivated screening seeds for a starting bundle that permits further expansion. They measure growth, not question quality; the samples are small and the first study used a more restrictive certification executor.
blocks.zh: 根后能继续,比可得到的线索数量还要多. 在轨迹研究中,在根成功后,70个运行中没有一个没有可用的实体. 在100种子研究中,21个失败跑道中的13个在根后没有可用的实体,而没有成功跑道存在这个问题. 这些结果激发了对种子的筛选,使其开始捆绑,从而可以进一步扩大。 它们衡量生长,而不是质疑质量;样品很少,第一次研究使用更严格的认证执行人.

blocks.en: Appendix B SELECT and EXPAND
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: Candidate construction. We retain conditions with an allowed property, a labelled neighbour, at least two candidates and support beyond deprecated-only statements. We exclude given-name and family-name clues, cap the pool at 24 conditions and spread it across properties. Exact target queries stop after finding a second answer. We enumerate singletons, pairs and triples: a certified smaller bundle needs no added condition, and a larger bundle is retained only if each immediate sub-bundle admits another answer. This checks certification and necessity during enumeration.
blocks.zh: 候选建筑. 我们保留一个允许的财产、一个贴有标签的邻国、至少两名候选人和支持的条件,这些条件不仅限于被贬低的言论。 我们排除了给定的名字和姓的线索, 封顶游泳池24个条件,并把它分散到各个属性。 精确目标查询在找到第二个答案后停止. 我们列举了单数,对数和三分数:一个经认证的更小的捆绑不需要附加条件,一个更大的捆绑只有在每个直接的分捆都承认另一个答案时才会被保留. 检查查点时的证明和必要性。

blocks.en: SELECT requires at least two usable conditions and a non-redundant named entity. If more than 20 entities qualify, we keep those with the most usable conditions. Each relation profile shows up to eight direction–neighbour-type groups and the three most frequent properties in each group. EXPAND ranks bundles by size, then by the sum of individual candidate counts, and presents up to 50 per shortlist. Enumeration allows 600 certification queries per step and 30 minutes per seed.
blocks.zh: SELECT至少需要两个可用的条件和一个非多余的命名实体. 如果超过20个实体符合资格,我们就保留那些具有最可用条件的实体。 每个关系简介显示最多8个方向-邻居类型组以及每个组中最常出现的3个属性. EXPAND按大小排列,然后按个人候选人数的总和排列,每个短名单最多50人。 编号允许每步600个认证查询,每个种子30分钟.

blocks.en: Entity-level tests. We tested entity measures against successful expansion in the 100-seed probe and in the replayed trajectories (446 attempted entities). Table 6 separates static measures from checks of an entity’s contribution to the current question graph.
blocks.zh: 实体一级的测试。 我们在100种子探测器和重播轨迹中测试了针对成功扩张的实体措施(446个未遂实体)。 表6将静态措施与检查实体对本问题图表的贡献分开。

blocks.en: Table 6: Predictors of successful entity expansion. Static measures use the 100-seed probe; entity-necessity measures use replayed trajectories. ∗ Computed only for resolvable queries.
blocks.zh: 表6:成功实体扩展的预测者。 静态度量使用百种探测器;实体-必要度量使用回放轨迹. * 仅用于可解答的查询。

blocks.en: Static measures were close to chance, whereas the entity’s role in the current graph was informative. Among 647 selected entities passing entity necessity in the 100-seed probe, 632 expanded successfully (97.7%). We therefore use entity necessity as a gate and give the LLM relation profiles instead of static degree scores. These observations motivate the design; they do not isolate its effect through a controlled ablation.
blocks.zh: 静态措施几乎是偶然的,而该实体在目前图表中的作用是翔实的。 在通过100种子探测器的实体必要性的647个选定实体中,632个已成功扩展(97.7%)。 因此,我们将实体必要性作为大门,并给出LLM关系简介,而不是静态学位分数。 这些观测激发了设计;它们不会通过受控的衰减来隔离其效果.

blocks.en: The written question asks for the race distance: A motor race took place on a street circuit during a season featuring an event in a Belgian province. A driver from the same motorsport discipline as Jos Verstappen won that Belgian event. That same driver also won an award that Jackie Stewart once received. I can’t quite remember the specifics of the race distance for that street circuit event; how many laps long was it? The expected answer is 78 laps. The graph identifies the race; its event-distance statement supplies the quantity.

blocks.en: Appendix D Solving-trace instructions
blocks.zh: 附录 D 解决跟踪指令

blocks.en: We collect traces with Gemini-3.1-flash-lite at temperature zero and no thinking, using the graph functions in Table 3 . Additional graph-derived clues support navigation during collection; the exported prompt omits them. The condensed instructions are: ⬇ Answer the supplied question through the graph functions in a persistent Python REPL . Use one Python block per turn . Keep intermediate results in variables ; print useful summaries . Reuse earlier results . Do not invent identifiers or facts . Use llm_query or llm_map only to interpret supplied evidence ; batch related items and validate the returned answers in code . Finish with FINAL ( value ) or FINAL_VAR ( value ) in the requested format . LIMITS 30 turns ; up to 80 helper calls ; visible output capped at 10,000 characters . Graph reads are measured but not capped . TASK INPUTS question : < natural - language question > answer_format : < typed answer schema > collection_clues : < graph - derived clues ; no answer supplied > We retain exact-answer traces and prune error turns when later turns do not depend on them. These are assisted collection traces for future training; evaluation uses no collection clues.
blocks.zh: 我们利用表3中的图表功能,在零温下收集双子座-3.1-闪光升的痕迹。 附加出图的线索支持了收集过程中的导航;被导出的快取省去. 缩放指令有: QQ 通过持续 Python REPL 中的图函数来回答所提供的问题 。 每转弯使用一个Python块. 在变量中保留中间结果;打印有用的摘要。 重用早期结果 。 不发明识别码或事实。 使用 llm_query 或 llm_ map 只用于解释提供的证据; 批次相关项目并验证代码中返回的答案 。 以所请求的格式以 Finish (value) 或 Finish_VAR (value) 完成 。 LIMITS 30转; 最多80个帮助呼叫; 可见输出封顶为一万个字符. 图中读取的图是测量的,但没有封顶。 TASK INPUTS 问题: < 自然- 语言问题 > 答案- 格式: < 键入解答计划 > 集合- clues: < 图表- 衍生出线索;未提供答案 > 我们保留准确的答题痕迹,如果后期的答题不取决于这些答题,则prune错误转弯。 这些是用于未来培训的辅助收集痕迹;评价没有使用收集线索。
